title: irregular beat
task: Beat-to-beat flags from a heart-rate sensor -> regular / isolated premature beat / irregular rhythm.
signal: 17 simulated RR intervals give 16 flags (beat-to-beat change above 12 % of the mean RR); regular rhythm has 3 % jitter and a 4 % respiratory swing, a premature beat is one or two short-long pairs, an irregular rhythm has 20 % random RR variation.
model_size: LogicDense(16,48) -> LogicDense(48,48) -> GroupSum(3, tau=4): 96 two-input logic gates; input 16 x 1-bit
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
